notes: All evidence is Le Journal des Entreprises (French trade press, basis=reported); no company release was fetchable (renfusion.eu homepage archived but carries no funding text; web search budget exhausted). The article says a Series A2 might follow by end 2025: not recorded (no evidence of closing). Amounts for the two investors in A1 are not individually disclosed. Do not add the census 62M USD figure: the sum of 15M + 10M grant + 32M is not a round. Not recorded: DIFFER/VDL partnership (no date or amount in the snapshot). The 2023 round's "Seed" label was also not in the source (relabelled). Amounts and participants match the quotes; all evidence remains trade press only (basis reported), no company or Bpifrance primary.
